name: Qing-Shang-Fang-Feng-Tang (Chinese herbal formula)
short: Cited evidence is only for it taken with Xiao-Feng-San: in a placebo-controlled pilot trial in chronic urticaria (56 analysed), well tolerated, no noticeable long-term side effects. No event data.
text: The only safety evidence found is for Qing-Shang-Fang-Feng-Tang taken together with a second formula, Xiao-Feng-San, not on its own. In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot study in chronic urticaria, the two formulas or placebo were given with the antihistamine levocetirizine for 28 days, followed by 28 days of levocetirizine alone; 78 people entered screening and 56 were included in the final analysis. The authors report that the herbal prescription was well tolerated with no noticeable long-term side effects compared with the control group; the abstract does not say whether shorter-term side effects occurred, list any adverse events or give numbers, and it does not list the herbs in either formula. No interaction data were found in the cited source.

citations.label: Yang et al., 2018, Front Pharmacol
citations.title: The Efficacy and Safety of a Fixed Combination of Chinese Herbal Medicine in Chronic Urticaria: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Pilot Study.
